title: Seoul National University Hospital skips cybersecurity disclosure for years despite breach affecting 830,000
content_md: This is one of those headlines where our first thought was “Uh oh!” but then we read more and thought “Hmmm…” Ko Jae-woo reports: Seoul National University Hospital has not filed a mandatory cybersecurity disclosure for years, an investigation has found.
